status: APPLICATION for the maintainer: P1 (teacher generation) + P1v (its $0 verification, corpus build and B's real pack) ONLY -- 2026-10-22 UTC, after the maintainer's design choices. AUTHORIZES NOTHING: no grant is issued, no cap is raised, no Stage-0 authorization is reused, no resource is created by this file. The whole-H1 package is NOT requested; P1g and P2 are separate later applications (sequencing).
scope: generate the teacher candidates of arm B's generated cells (plans/generation_plan.json) on one A100-80GB session, bring every record home, then verify, select and pack on the dev box at $0. Nothing is trained, evaluated or stored on paid storage.

generation_list.what: per (stratum, source) cell of stage2.reasoning_master@v1: the tasks drawn (round-robin over generator x difficulty / module x level, in pool order, never by a result), the cell's units, the named rate basis, expected units and the generated-token upper bound; the run_battery inputs and their sha256
generation_list.only_verifiable: every task has a usable project verifier (generation_plan.verifier_of): comparators, checkers.CHECKERS, supporting_verify.VERIFIERS, the battery scorer or environment replay
generation_list.inputs_location: artifacts/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/generation_inputs/ (dev box, gitignored; sha256 in the plan; rebuilt byte-identically by generation_plan from the committed pools)

scale: plans/generation_plan.json :: totals (tasks, episodes, expected_generated_tokens_upper) and cells
acceptance_basis: plans/generation_plan.json :: cells[].rate_basis: measured on the same generators where the teacher has run (Stage-0 teacher_cal, re-counted at the 8,184 allowance), otherwise a NAMED PROXY (the same axis on teacher_cal; corpus_v2's nearest type) or the spec's labelled code assumption (0.4), with a larger margin for proxied cells. Known optimistic proxies: PrOntoQA's process gate and the answerability rate (borrowed from answerable rag questions) are not measured

resources.gpu: 1 x A100-80GB, one session, at most one billing resource (teacher_cal's measured GPU, engine and price: plans/cost_forecast.json :: measured.teacher_generation)
resources.engine: vLLM 0.27.1 image as teacher_cal; run_battery --mode generate under scripts/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/generation_driver.py
resources.hours: plans/cost_forecast.json :: generation (gpu_hours at the measured tokens/s; session_hours_with_contingency)
resources.no_model_code_on_the_pod: the pod generates text only; code candidates are executed afterwards in the probed dev-box sandbox

failure_and_teardown_reserve.behaviour: generation_driver writes each finished pass group's tagged records and its .done sha256 at once, so a later failure loses nothing finished; a rerun regenerates nothing already done; one terminal path writes the evidence and ALL_DONE / RUN_FAILED; teardown and provider reconciliation are the launcher's

persistence.summary: EXISTING storage suffices: records of about 0.1 GB per copy go to the dev box (launcher fetch, sha-checked against .done) and to the relay (capacity probed 2026-10-22T15:53Z: 2 x 150 MB, 1 GB and 2 GB accepted), read back and hash-compared before teardown. No network volume is created for P1; the 30 GB volume is the preferred TRAINING backend, a separate authorization

budget_occupancy.conservative_rule: occupy the PROVIDER's all-time billing (each charge counted once: no record total is added on top, so nothing is double-counted, and no unknown cost is written off): conservative headroom -$14.49 against the $643.6571 cap. Attribution of the 34 unnamed pods and the anchor's meaning stay OPEN; this rule asserts neither
budget_occupancy.what_p1_needs: P1's hard cap (plans/cost_forecast.json :: p1_application.totals.hard_cap_usd) inside the cap. Under the conservative rule that needs a cap of at least provider all-time + P1's hard cap, i.e. a rise of $14.49 + that hard cap; if the maintainer instead states that the records are complete (the anchor covered all earlier spend), the record headroom (+$18.08) already covers it. The agent chooses neither and raises nothing
budget_occupancy.before_create: a fresh provider reconciliation (0 pods, 0 volumes, $0/h) and the same-failure gate, as every paid session

decisions_needed_for_P1: the P1 envelope and the cap under one of the two budget readings above (budget_occupancy)
freezing the generation protocol for this run (configs/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/generation_protocol.json, its sha256 into the authorization)
the generation plan as the authorized plan (generation_list.generation_plan_sha256; generation_driver refuses any other)
engineering_before_the_P1_launch_at_0_us: launcher wiring for the generation session in the existing session runner (session kind, pod setup, the issuer of the generation authorization under generation_driver.POLICY, the pod test selection) and its launch-bound sweep
a relay capacity re-probe at true size and a fresh provider reconciliation at launch

phases.what: $0 audit, design, builders, chain, driver and tests (2026-10-21/22)
phases.status: done for P1; see docs/stages/stage-2/reasoning_data/H1.md section 11

phases.what: teacher generation of the plan's tasks, two candidate passes (one A100-80GB session)
generation_adapter on every record (sandboxed code), isolation re-check, build_arm_b -> B's real pack, h1_accounting --pack-b (M1 values), forecast_cost (P2's cost) -- dev box CPU
failure / teardown / evidence reserve for the one P1 session

not_requested_now.P1g: small GPU validation of the training changes and the unit driver (plans/cost_forecast.json :: proposal_phases.P1g_gpu_validation, for reference)
not_requested_now.P2: the four formal units (proposal_phases.P2_formal_4_units, for reference; recomputed on B's real pack)
not_requested_now.storage: the 30 GB network volume for training (proposal_phases.storage_h1_backend_two_months, for reference)
not_requested_now.whole_h1_reference: plans/cost_forecast.json :: proposal_totals -- reference only, not an amount asked for

sequencing: DATA FIRST (maintainer 2026-10-22): this application covers P1 + P1v only. After B's real pack exists, M1's values and P2's cost are recomputed and frozen; a separate application then asks for P1g (with the training backend if it is needed by then); only after P1g passes is the four-unit P2 applied for.
proposed_grant_shape: one H1 envelope with per-phase hard caps; a one-use authorization per session bound to its plan hash (src/aadistill/governance/authorization.py); at most one billing resource at a time; the default-on provider-resource reconciliation and the same-failure gate before every create; the capacity probe at true size before any session that produces a student
